agentFrontmatter.hostParsed: name/description/mode belong to the host's agentMdToEntry — the adapter does not restate that grammar

boundsEnforcement: every emitted declaration is compiled through compileAlphaPackageDeclarationV1 with the derived asset tables before the adapter returns — Markdown per-asset and skill budgets, asset path grammar, and path depth are the compiler's own gates, not adapter restatements

mapped.context: exact value "fork" → behavior.subtask = true; any other value → review-required

componentSources.agents: agents/*.md files (or manifest.agents replacement list) → agent@1, targetDir alpha-agents
componentSources.commands: top-level commands/*.md flat files (or manifest.commands replacement list) → command@1 template leaves (alpha-code#840, #98 B1)
componentSources.mcp: manifest.mcpServers inline object or .mcp.json → mcp-local (stdio) / mcp-remote (url)
componentSources.rootSkillMd: single SKILL.md at plugin root → review-required (layout outside the pinned profile)
componentSources.skills: skills/<name>/SKILL.md directories (+ manifest.skills additions) → skill@1, targetDir alpha-skills, whole directory as assets

executableEvidence: capture entries with executable:true stay evidence only (#843): review-required finding alpha.claude-code.executable-evidence on the owning component; no mode in payloads, no chmod, no skipped component, no second host warning path

graph.root: first component by class order agent, skill, command, mcp — byte order inside a class

identity.forbidden: directory names and the literal "unknown" never mint identity
identity.packageId: package:<manifest.name>; missing name only from importSpec.packageName

mcp.malformed: a known server field with a wrong type (args not an all-string array, headers/env values not strings) is named blocked — never silently filtered into a smaller compatible config

placeholders.${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}: review-required only as a stdio server arg/env value that is the placeholder itself or the placeholder plus a traversal-free relative suffix (a provable workspace mapping); a suffix containing "..", backslashes, or control characters is blocked as workspace traversal; anywhere else blocked

mcp.stdio: command + args → behavior.command[1..16]; env (plain strings) → behavior.environment; requiredSecrets always []

templateBytes: the parsed markdown BODY only — frontmatter is provider configuration, never prompt text, so it is stripped before the template asset is bound; a command file whose frontmatter cannot be parsed by the pinned subset fails closed (blocked, component not emitted), and an empty body after stripping fails closed the same way. skill/agent assets stay verbatim: their frontmatter is what the host's own parsers read at install
